Desk.dc.html.title: Pharmacy Desk — one ticket, one screen

n1.text:
This board is live — press Play, or use the Tweaks panel to jump between the five stages.

Idle: scan, or search, or take a ticket from the line on the right.
Found: the left column lists his visits — the one marked "seen" opens the ticket.
Working: tick each drug off the shelf. The ⋯ on a line opens substitute; the ⋯ on the Alprazolam line opens the authorisation request.
Payment: the right column has become the bill.

Q opens the whole line as a popup. S shows the scribe's photograph.

n2.text:
Every figure on these boards comes from an endpoint that already ships: GET /pharmacy/summary, /pharmacy/queue and /pharmacy/reorder.

Today /pharmacy/summary answers seventeen figures and the counter shows them as one line of text under the title.
